# T14/T16: boot with an existing save (generated by a prior run), open title menu
loadsram build/save_after_play.bin
reset
autoshot
wait 700
tap start
wait 30
shot menu_default
tap down
wait 10
shot menu_down1
tap down
wait 10
shot menu_down2
tap up
tap up
wait 10
shot menu_up
tap a
wait 400
shot after_select
sram sram_after
